title: A consonant bias in dogs
abstract: Do dogs perceive speech similarly to humans? A recent work by Morvai et al. suggests that dogs develop a focus on consonants to identify words, resembling results observed in humans. This is likely the result of massive exposure to language combined with an evolutionarily ancient ability to track regularities in the signal.
abstract_zh: 狗是否像人类一样感知语言？Morvai 等人最近的一项研究表明，狗会专注于辅音来辨认单词，这与人类观察到的结果相似。这可能是由于大量的语言暴露以及进化古老的信号规律追踪能力所致。
